days.title: Historic Hills and Botanical Gardens
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: città Alta
stops.detail: The area, extending over 4700 [hectares] and including the historic area of the Upper City and the Bergamo hills, features numerous terraces with vegetable gardens, vineyards, and meadows.

stops.name: orto botanico
stops.detail: The park is considered the green lung of the city where there is the presence of a botanical garden with an educational trail.

stops.name: Ex convento di Santa Maria in Valmarina
stops.detail: The administrative headquarters of the park is located in the Former Convent of Santa Maria in Valmarina.

stops.name: Parco Agricolo Ecologico Madonna dei Campi
stops.detail: The inclusion into the protected area of the PLIS ‘Madonna dei Campi Ecological Agricultural Park’, in the neighborhoods of Grumello del Piano and Colognola, added 257 hectares to the Parco dei Colli and created a green belt south of the city of Bergamo, safeguarding an area that had remained without buildings in an otherwise heavily urbanized context.
